# 2one-system

> Single source of truth for the 2one design system — components, tokens, brand
> assets, and usage context — structured for humans and AI.

## Start here
- [Agent guide](AGENTS.md): how to work in this repo
- [Registry](registry.json): machine index of components, tokens, and known issues

## Components
- Source: components/<Name>/<Name>.tsx
- Published as: @yokesh-2one/ui

## Tokens
- tokens/colors.css, tokens/typography.css, tokens/spacing.css (Tailwind v4 @theme)

## Brand
- brand/logo/ — logo SVG + PNG + manifest (rules: no recolor, black on light / white on dark)

## Build targets
- recipes/ — app, website, marketing, deck
